guestData.title: Guest data
guestData.description: Export or delete what you store about your guests. Owners and managers only.
guestData.forbidden: Only owners and managers can export or delete guest data.
guestData.hotelDescription: A copy of every guest of the hotel with their consent log, or a full deletion.
guestData.deleteAllBody: This permanently deletes {count} guests of {hotel} with their consent history. It cannot be undone. Export first if you need a copy.
guestData.guestDescription: Find a guest by name, phone or email.
guestData.deleteGuestBody: This permanently deletes {name} and their consent history. It cannot be undone.
